mapper.select: select sum(pay_price) from eb_store_order where ${where} and refund_status = 0
select sum(refund_price) from eb_store_order where ${where} and refund_status = 2
select count(id) from eb_store_order where ${where} and refund_status = 2

select * from eb_store_order where uid = #{uid}
and `status` = 0 and `paid` = 0 and `refund_status` = 0 and `type` = 0
and `status` = 0 and `paid` = 1 and `refund_status` = 0
and `status` = 1 and `paid` = 1 and `refund_status` = 0
and `status` = 2 and `paid` = 1 and `refund_status` = 0
and `status` = 3 and `paid` = 1 and `refund_status` = 0
and `paid` = 1 and `refund_status` in(1,3)
and `paid` = 1 and `refund_status` = 2
and `paid` = 1 and `refund_status` in(1,2,3)
and is_del = 0 and is_system_del = 0
and (order_id like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') or order_id in (select order_no from eb_store_order_info where product_name like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%')))
order by id desc

select count(*) from eb_store_order as o left join eb_user as u on o.uid = u.uid where o.is_system_del = 0
and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 0 and o.status = 0 and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 1 and o.status = 0 and o.refund_status = 0 and o.shipping_type = 1 and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 1 and o.status = 0 and o.refund_status = 0 and o.shipping_type in (1, 2) and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 1 and o.status = 1 and o.refund_status = 0 and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 1 and o.status = 2 and o.refund_status = 0 and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 1 and o.status = 3 and o.refund_status = 0 and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 1 and o.status = 0 and o.refund_status = 0 and o.shipping_type = 2 and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 1 and o.refund_status in (1,3) and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 1 and o.refund_status = 2 and o.is_del = 0
and o.is_del = 1
and o.order_id like CONCAT('%',#{orderNo},'%')
and o.delivery_id like CONCAT('%',#{deliveryId},'%')
and o.pay_type = #{payType}
and o.type = #{type}
and o.paid = 1 and o.refund_status in (1,2,3) and o.is_del = 0
and o.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
and ( o.uid like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') or u.nickname like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') or u.phone like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%')
or o.order_id like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') or o.order_id in (select order_no from eb_store_order_info where product_name like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%'))
)
and o.uid = #{uid}
and u.nickname like CONCAT('%',#{nickname},'%')
and u.phone like CONCAT('%',#{phone},'%')

and o.paid = 1 and o.status = 2 and o.refund_status = 0 and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 1 and o.status = 3 and o.refund_status = 0 and o.is_del = 0
and o.paid = 1 and o.status = 0 and o.refund_status = 0 and o.shipping_type = 2 and o.is_del = 0

and o.type = #{type}
and o.paid = 1 and o.refund_status in (1,2,3) and o.is_del = 0
